tape_read.note: Robust reference 49.31 (-13.7%) against my frozen release read of -3% and an implied move of 16.6%; after-hours was -5.5% at 54.00. Pre-market is stale: 9 prints, 2 in the last 30 minutes, last at 08:48, flagged stale_at_open. Thin float (12.3M), wide spreads. The market prices the growth miss much harder than my read; the name's history (-16%, -26% on growth disappointments) says such moves can stick, so the overshoot call is low confidence.

thesis_check.note: The short thesis was weak growth after Progressive's competitive read with an EPS beat that gets sold: GWP -8% YoY, premiums in force down, PIF flat, EPS beat. The revenue miss is smaller than the hunt's 1-2% arithmetic.

expected.open_lag_note: Stale, thin pre-market (last print 08:48, after-hours only -5.5%) makes the open less reliable than usual, so the chance it holds under half of -13.7% is above the base rate; an amc gap this large, read overnight, tends to give some back by 10:00, and the move already exceeds what the release reads to me.

recommendation.reason: De short staat voorbeurs al ruim 10% in de plus: het aandeel noteert rond 13,7% lager, veel meer dan de cijfers volgens ons rechtvaardigen (winst ruim boven verwachting, groei zwak maar in lijn met de eigen prognose, plus inkoop van eigen aandelen). Grote dalingen na cijfers die 's nachts al verwerkt zijn, veren vaak deels terug, dus dek de short in bij de opening, zoals de standaardregel ook doet.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de voorbeurs vlak voor 09:30 actief verder zakt onder 49 dollar met meerdere nieuwe transacties, of er komen koersdoelverlagingen binnen, dan is vasthouden tot 10:00 te verdedigen.
